- Minimal fix direction: in the vault sync, replace the TASK-0008 entry with the current handover state ("implementation + independent review complete; owner review pending; on acceptance the owner tags `2026.09.5`"), or delete the entry under the existing compaction rule (merge it into the task file's Execution Record), matching how TASK-0007's entry was retired. No P0. No P1.
